statement: A principal's attributes cannot be changed once its authenticator has returned it: they are what the host reads from its SecurityContext and what every further check of the request decides on (subject.attributes.*). AuthenticatedPrincipal keeps a read-only view of the map it is handed, and CoSec's token verifier makes the attributes claim read-only at every level, nested objects and arrays included. A change through the principal, at any level, throws, and a further check decides as the first did; what is read is what the authenticator handed over.
